name: Good And Evil
overview: Scripture reveals the profound reality of the moral conflict between good and evil, beginning with Adam and Eve's pivotal choice as introduced in Genesis 3:1, where deception led to disobedience. Believers are exhorted to deliberately choose to serve the LORD, as Joshua 24:15 challenges each person to decide whom they will serve. The Psalms and Proverbs consistently call for turning away from evil and actively pursuing good, emphasizing a life of obedience and reverence toward God as the foundation for true wisdom and peace.
